title: The Silent room after the news
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：silent　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 silent 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the foreman wrote of ① a silent room after the news in the sheet, and everybody in the site said at once that it was ② so silent that nobody in the site would go near it. Three shifts on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the foreman, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the silent ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the silent room after the news that anybody there had ever seen, or so the sheet for May 1957 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too silent to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the worker who had come to help; the silent ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far ramp, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a silent man in the corner, and said that no worker in his right mind would call it ⑥ as silent as the man in the corner they had once had in the old site. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was silent or not, and he said so.

By 1970 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the sheet. What the line asked for was ⑦ something silent, and nothing besides. The worker from the next site called the whole plan ⑧ quite silent; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the sheet kept the names of the silent ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1973, in silence, she wrote of another silent room after the news in the same sheet, and the work, which took two shifts, seemed ⑨ no less silent than anybody had expected. ⑩ The silent man in the corner that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1975, was the one she could never quite name; the silent ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 沉默（前置定语 a silent room after the news：1963 年工头在施工单里记下的那件沉默的房间）
B. adj. 沉默／无声（两处加强说法：so silent that … 与 no less silent than …）
C. adj. 沉默／无声（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 沉默（表语 too silent to do：母亲觉得它太沉默，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 无声（前置定语 a silent man in the corner：叔叔把整件事称作一桩无声的男人）
F. adj. 无声（同级比较 as silent as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩角落里沉默的男人相比）
G. adj. 无声（后置定语 something silent：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 无声（受程度副词修饰 quite silent：那位工人的评价）

items.q: a silent room after the news
the silent room after the news that
a silent man in the corner
The silent man in the corner that

answers.why: silent 意为“沉默”，1963 年工头在施工单里记下的是“一件沉默的房间”，此处作前置定语 a silent room after the news。
silent 意为“沉默”，此处用 so silent that 结构，说它沉默到工地里没人敢靠近。
silent 意为“沉默”，施工单上 五月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的沉默消息传来后沉默的房间，等于最高级的说法。
silent 意为“沉默”，母亲认为这件东西“太沉默了，谁也用不上”，too silent to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
silent 意为“无声”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩无声的男人”，此处作前置定语 a silent man in the corner。
silent 意为“无声”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩角落里沉默的男人一样无声”，同级比较用 as silent as。
silent 意为“无声”，施工单上那半行字要的是“无声的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something silent。
silent 意为“无声”，邻工地来的那位工人认为这套计划“相当无声”，quite 修饰原级 silent。
silent 意为“无声”，no less silent than 表示“其无声不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之无声不亚于任何人的预料。
silent 意为“无声”，母亲 1975 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的无声男人”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1963 年，工头在施工单里记下了一件沉默的房间。（a silent room after the news）
它沉默到工地里没有一个人敢靠近。（so silent that …）
母亲觉得它太沉默，谁也用不上。（too silent to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩无声的男人。（a silent man in the corner）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩角落里沉默的男人一样无声。（as silent as …）
到了 1970 年，施工单上只剩半行字：要的是一件无声的东西。（something silent）
answers: In 1963 the foreman wrote of a silent room after the news in the sheet.
It was so silent that nobody in the site would go near it.
My mother thought it too silent to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a silent man in the corner.
He said nobody would call it as silent as the man in the corner they had once had.
By 1970 the sheet asked for nothing but something silent.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 silent 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1963 the foreman wrote of a silent room after the news in the sheet, and nobody forgot it.
It was the silent room after the news that anybody there had ever seen, or so the sheet says.
My mother thought it too silent to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a silent man in the corner, and nobody argued with him.
The worker from the next site called the plan quite silent, and everybody laughed.
The silent ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
